name: task-platform
description: Two-app platform: customer (post work / find cabs) + worker (freelancer & service-firm ops). Shares a Rust/Axum backend and OTA pipeline.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:customer && npm run build:worker
scripts.api:sync: npm run api:export && npm run api:codegen
scripts.postinstall: npm run api:sync --if-present || echo 'api:sync skipped (Rust toolchain unavailable) — run manually before typechecking'
scripts.release:ota:customer: npm run api:sync && npm run bundle:ota:customer:prod
scripts.release:ota:worker: npm run api:sync && npm run bundle:ota:worker:prod
scripts.release:ota: npm run api:sync && npm run bundle:ota:customer:prod && npm run bundle:ota:worker:prod
